references.text: Moses gave the land to the tribe of Reuben, the tribe of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh, as mentioned here in Joshua 12:6.
Moses describes how he gave the land to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh.
Refers to the conquest of the land and its distribution to Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh.
Describes the victory over Sihon and the conquest of his land, which was later given to the tribes.
Tells of the victory over Og, king of Bashan, who is also mentioned in connection with Joshua 12:6.
Explains the inheritance that Moses gave to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh on the east side of the Jordan.
Joshua sends the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh back to their inheritance that Moses had given them.
Moses' servant Joshua reminds Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh of the promise they made to Moses to help the other tribes.
